metadata.scope: The six packet-listed Value cells only; independent source-entry review, not historical-linguistic sign-off.
metadata.method: Fresh-context independent AI reviewer opened each unique ID row in the pinned UTF-8 CSVs, displayed its raw CSV row, Value, escaped Value, and full Unicode code-point sequence, then transcribed the Value without normalization. Local source bytes were compared with separately fetched commit-pinned raw GitHub CSV bytes.
metadata.packet_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(packet, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) with default separators and no trailing newline; matches the supplied response template.
limitations: AI review by a separate agent task; reviewer_id is a task identifier, not an authenticated human identity.
The agent did not participate in import/encoding and received no expected imported values; filesystem read separation was enforced by instruction in a shared workspace, not by a sandbox.
No human or language-family-specialist sign-off; no evaluation of source scholarship, cognacy, phonological analysis, or historical claims.
Only six packet-selected cells were reviewed; this is not a review of every core record.
